cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import re
s=open('/tmp/main.js',errors='ignore').read()
# cari content-type/accept yang dipakai untuk account creation
for m in list(re.finditer(r'account\.creation',s))[:6]:
    print(re.sub(r'\s+',' ',s[max(0,m.start()-150):m.start()+120]),"\n")
PY
